prompts.court: Use case: stylized-concept. Create an original 3D game environment concept for an adapted Bengali Rajbari heritage estate in a premium Kolkata Roblox district. The two attached photographs are architectural references, not textures to copy: white classical entablatures over warm exposed terracotta brick, tall paired columns, shuttered upper verandas, symmetrical broad stairs and an intimate lawn court. Camera: elevated three-quarter courtyard view showing the entire compact U-shaped estate, two shallow side wings, a stronger central Thakur Dalan at the far end, a modest ceremonial pavilion/mandap integrated to the right side of the lawn, clear walking paths and a compact front entry. Compressed heroic player scale, about 190 by 175 studs, two main storeys with selective architectural detail. Preserve Bengali mansion identity, cream cornices, ochre-grey shutters, red brick and restrained bougainvillea in pots. Low-to-mid-poly, crisp geometry, shared materials, readable silhouette and grounded columns. The Durga Puja mandap is a finished raised ceremonial stage with tasteful Bengali arch/frame and space for later festival installation; no crowds or idols required. Bright daytime. No photorealism, no dense micro carving, no giant grounds, no modern skyscrapers, no labels, no floor-plan text, no furniture-filled interiors. This is a concept to guide actual Blender modeling.
prompts.approach: Use case: stylized-concept. Original 3D game environment concept for a compact Tier 1 Bengali Rajbari estate. Use references 1 and 2 for warm exposed-brick classical columns, cream cornices, two-storey verandas, broad central stairs and lawn court. Use reference 3 ONLY for the long low red-and-cream street facade and modest central drum/dome. Eye-level elevated front three-quarter approach, complete estate in frame: a handsome low red palace gatehouse with a real central arched walkthrough and modest domed pavilion, balanced wings, visible tall brick-columned rear Thakur Dalan beyond its internal courtyard. Compact rectangular approximately 200 by 200 studs. A dedicated restrained ceremonial mandap in the right side of the inner court, left lawn, wide axial pedestrian path. Premium stylized low-to-mid-poly Roblox architecture, cream trim, muted terracotta, ochre-grey shutters, warm gold highlights, clean solid geometry, grounded columns, purposeful plinths, compact grounds. Bright daytime. No crowds, no labels, no text, no full interiors, no photorealism, no tiny decorative noise, no giant park, no extra skyscrapers. Guide actual modular Blender modeling.
prompts.mandap: Use case: stylized-concept. Original architectural game concept, courtyard-level three-quarter view of a finished Durga Puja mandap SPACE inside a compact Bengali Rajbari estate, using supplied photographs for cream entablatures, brick classical columns and taupe shutters. Show the dedicated raised 34 by 26 stud ceremonial stage on the RIGHT SIDE of the courtyard with a compact solid curved Bengali roof canopy, four cream/terracotta columns, deep maroon recessed arch backdrop edged gold, a modest stylized lotus crest and steps facing the lawn. The center of the stage is empty and usable for a future Puja installation; do not add an idol, furniture or crowds. A green lawn is on the left and clear stone circulation connects stage and broad rear mansion steps. Two-storey U-shaped verandas, white entablatures and warm brick columns frame the scene. High-quality stylized low-to-mid-poly Roblox-feasible geometry, crisp shapes, readable cultural detail, restrained planting, no ornament spam, no photorealism, no huge grounds, no signs or text. Bright warm daylight.
